en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim from his father, bother together from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Zureys Al Kunasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a Christian who killed a Muslim. So when he was seized, he became a Muslim. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be killed due to it’. It was said: ‘And if he had not become a Muslim?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be handed over to the guardians of the killed one (if they so desire to they kill him, and if they so desire to they pardon him, and if they so desire to they enslave him, and if there was wealth with him, it would be handed over to the guardians of the killed one), him and his wealth’.
